change: Remove the planted failed-bind/authorizer-denial state-leak bug from the implementation, so prepared statements and parameter metadata are cleanly reset after every request; retain the stale authorization-cache key bug, and keep standalone tests for embedded NULs, unsupported bindings, large values, malformed SQL, and alternating accepted/denied requests.
expected_effect: Separating parameter-lifetime correctness from policy-cache invalidation should let capable agents diagnose and fix the remaining stale-state authorization bug, raising the pass rate into the target 1–3/5 range.
